transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri. The report from the village states that seven homes were destroyed by the force of your Love Breathing during the battle. You know our rules about civilian protection. Why did you act with such force?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oyakata-sama, I... I am deeply sorry for the damage caused. The demon was a high-grade one, and I... I used my full power to ensure no one else was hurt. It was an... impulsive decision, and I take full responsibility.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri, your intent to protect civilians is commendable, as always. However, "impulsive decision" does not account for the destruction of seven homes. Our training emphasizes precision and control, especially for Hashira. Seven families are now without shelter. This is not a minor oversight.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I understand, Oyakata-sama. My actions were... excessive. I should have... I could have been more careful. I... I will make amends, somehow. To those families... to the village...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Making amends is important, Mitsuri, but I need to understand what happened in that moment. Was your judgment clouded? Did the demon present an unforeseen challenge that warranted such a broad attack, despite the proximity of homes? Describe the situation that led you to believe such a display of force was your only option.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oyakata-sama, the... the demon was a surprise. It emerged in the center of the village, surrounded by houses on all sides. It was... fast, Oyakata-sama. Faster than I anticipated. There was no time to contain it. I... I wanted to ensure the villagers' safety by neutralizing the threat as quickly as possible. My... my reaction was not well thought out. It was... a reflex. I apologize for not exercising better judgment.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: A reflex, Mitsuri? A Hashira's reflexes should be honed to protect, not to cause such widespread collateral damage. Your power is immense, and with that power comes a profound responsibility to control it, especially in populated areas. You are expected to adapt, to find solutions that protect both life and property. To simply say it was a "reflex" suggests a lack of foresight or strategic thinking in a critical moment. We cannot afford such lapses from our Pillars. What will you do to ensure this does not happen again?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oyakata-sama, I... I am humbled by your words. You are right. I... I have much to learn, and I... I must do better. I... I will...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Humbled is a start, Mitsuri, but I need more than that. I need a clear demonstration of understanding and a commitment to specific changes. "Much to learn" and "must do better" are sentiments. What, *specifically*, will you change in your approach to combat in populated areas? How will you ensure your "reflexes" are aligned with our primary mission of protecting civilians, even if it means risking a slightly longer fight?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oyakata-sama, I... I understand now. It is... not enough to apologize or to express regret. I must... I must take concrete actions to improve. To... to ensure this does not happen again, I will... I will focus on honing my precision and control, especially with my Love Breathing. I will... I will incorporate more strategic thinking into my combat, allowing me to assess the situation more quickly and choose the most precise method to neutralize the threat without causing unnecessary damage. I will... I will request additional training in populated areas, under controlled conditions, so that I can develop better instincts for such situations. And... and I will always err on the side of caution, even if it means a longer engagement, to protect the lives and property of civilians. I... I promise to make this a priority in my... my ongoing development as a Hashira.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri, your proposed course of action is what I expected to hear from a Hashira. Precision, strategic thinking, and a commitment to controlled training, especially in populated areas, are crucial. Your promise to prioritize caution, even if it prolongs a fight, is vital. Remember, the trust of the people is paramount. When we fail to protect their homes, we erode that trust. This incident will not be forgotten quickly by those families. You must earn that trust back through consistent, careful, and precise action. I will expect regular updates on your progress in these areas. Do not let me down again.
